explanation: Eta electroproduction on the proton requires W >= m_p + m_eta ≈ 1.486 GeV (threshold ≈ 1.487–1.488 GeV per eta grid / EtaMAID tables). Requested W = 1.45 GeV is below the eta production threshold, so the kinematics is physically impossible regardless of being above the Delta (W ≈ 1.23 GeV). No EXCLURAD input can be generated for this point in the eta (ep->e'p eta) configuration. If a pion channel was intended, use ./pion with appropriate parameters; otherwise raise W to >= ~1.49 GeV.
